scripts.build: node scripts/bump-version.js && node scripts/build-images.js && node scripts/extract-agent-constants.js && esbuild src/js/script-v2.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --outfile=script-v2.js && esbuild src/js/admin.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --outfile=admin.js && esbuild src/js/tracking.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --outfile=tracking.js && esbuild src/js/agent-chat.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --outfile=agent-chat.js && cleancss -o style.css src/css/style.css
scripts.dev: node scripts/bump-version.js && node scripts/extract-agent-constants.js && node -e "[['src/js/admin.js','admin.js'],['src/js/script-v2.js','script-v2.js'],['src/css/style.css','style.css'],['src/js/tracking.js','tracking.js'],['src/js/agent-chat.js','agent-chat.js']].forEach(([s,d])=>{require('fs').copyFileSync(s,d);console.log('copied',s,'->', d)})"
